attchmntText: Salasar Techno Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Salasar Techno Engineering Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the re-appointment of Mr. Jai Krishan Aggarwal, DIN 01060175, and Mr. Rajesh Agrawal, DIN 08765416, as Non-Executive Independent Directors. The re-appointments are for a second term of three consecutive years, commencing January 11, 2027, and ending January 10, 2030. Both appointments are subject to the approval of the company's members. The Board confirmed that neither director is related to any other director and both satisfy independence criteria under the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI Listing Regulations. Additionally, both directors are not debarred from holding office by SEBI or any other authority.

attchmntText: Salasar Techno Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Salasar Techno Engineering Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. The trading window for the company's securities will open on November 16, 2026. The auditor issued a limited review report with no material misstatements noted. However, the report highlights an Emphasis of Matter regarding a provisional attachment order from the Enforcement Directorate under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002, dated September 12, 2026. This order attaches immovable properties in Durg, Chhattisgarh, and Naini, Uttar Pradesh, to the extent of Rs. 98.31 Crores for 180 days or until judicial decision. The company states manufacturing activities on these premises are unrestricted. The financial results include a significant deferred tax credit of Rs. 75,047.99 Lakhs recognized due to the amalgamation with EMC Limited.
